name: alongside
description: Alongside — a conversational daily companion that helps older adults living alone follow their own routines.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @alongside/shared && npm run build -w @alongside/server && npm run build -w @alongside/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @alongside/shared && npm run typecheck -w @alongside/server && npm run typecheck -w @alongside/web
